mapper.select: select c.complain_id, cc.category_name, u.complainuser_name, c.complain_status_cd, c.rcpt_dt, c.proc_dt, c.due_dt from t2000_complain c join t2000_complain_user u on c.complainuser_no = u.complainuser_no join t2000_complain_category cc on c.complain_category_id = cc.complain_category_id where c.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_COMPLAIN ( COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID, COMPLAINUSER_NO, ACCOUNT_ID, COMPLAIN_STATUS_CD, DEADLINE_DT, RECEIVER_ACCOUNT_ID ) VALUES ( #{complainCategoryId}, #{complainuserNo}, #{accountId}, #{complainStatusCd}, #{deadlineDt}, #{receiverAccountId} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.complain_id, to_char(c.rcpt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as rcptDt, to_char(c.deadline_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as deadlineDt, c.complain_Category_Id, c.complain_status_cd, u.user_name,g.category_name,r.complainuser_name,g.category_url FROM t2000_complain c JOIN t1000_department_work d ON d.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id JOIN t1000_account a ON a.dept_id = d.department_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no = u.user_no join t2000_complain_category g on g.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id join t2000_complain_user r on c.complainuser_no = r.complainuser_no WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT c.complain_id, TO_CHAR(c.rcpt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcptDt, TO_CHAR(c.deadline_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS deadlineDt, c.complain_category_id, c.complain_status_cd, g.category_name, g.category_url, r.complainuser_name, c.account_id, u.user_name FROM t2000_complain c JOIN t2000_complain_category g ON g.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id JOIN t2000_complain_user r ON r.complainuser_no = c.complainuser_no LEFT JOIN t1000_account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN t1000_user u ON u.user_no = a.user_no WHERE c.complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}

SELECT c.complain_id, TO_CHAR(c.rcpt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcptDt, TO_CHAR(c.deadline_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS deadlineDt, c.complain_category_id, c.complain_status_cd, g.category_name, g.category_url, r.complainuser_name, c.account_id, u.user_name FROM t2000_complain c JOIN t2000_complain_category g ON g.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id JOIN t2000_complain_user r ON r.complainuser_no = c.complainuser_no LEFT JOIN t1000_account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN t1000_user u ON u.user_no = a.user_no WHERE c.complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}
AND c.complain_status_cd = #{status}
AND r.complainuser_name LIKE '%' || #{complainUserName} || '%'
AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{manager} || '%'
AND c.deadline_dt >= TO_DATE(#{startDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.deadline_dt < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND c.rcpt_dt >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.rcpt_dt < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY c.complain_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.complain_id, TO_CHAR(c.rcpt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcptDt, TO_CHAR(c.deadline_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS deadlineDt, c.complain_category_id, c.complain_status_cd, g.category_name, g.category_url, r.complainuser_name, c.account_id, u.user_name FROM t2000_complain c JOIN t2000_complain_category g ON g.complain_category_id = c.complain_category_id JOIN t2000_complain_user r ON r.complainuser_no = c.complainuser_no LEFT JOIN t1000_account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN t1000_user u ON u.user_no = a.user_no WHERE c.complain_category_id IN ( SELECT dw.complain_category_id FROM t1000_department_work dw JOIN t1000_account acc ON acc.dept_id = dw.department_id WHERE acc.account_id = #{accountId} )
AND c.complain_status_cd = 'B001'
AND c.complain_category_id = #{filter.complainCategoryId}
AND r.complainuser_name LIKE '%' || #{filter.complainUserName} || '%'
AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{filter.manager} || '%'
AND c.deadline_dt >= TO_DATE(#{filter.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.deadline_dt < TO_DATE(#{filter.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND c.rcpt_dt >= TO_DATE(#{filter.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND c.rcpt_dt < TO_DATE(#{filter.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY c.complain_id DESC OFFSET #{filter.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{filter.size} ROWS ONLY
